newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sells 11.2 bln dmk 6-month Bubills, yld 2.94 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sells 11.2 bln dmk 6-month Bubills, yld 2.94 pct.

text.p: The German government on Wednesday issued 11.21 billion marks of six-month German Treasury discount paper, or Bubills, at a lowest accepted price of 98.525 and for a yield of 2.94 percent, the Bundesbank said as the issuing agent.
The pay date is January 17 and the paper matures on July 18, 1997, the Bundesbank said.
Bonn sells 11.2 bln dmk 6-mo Bubills, yld 2.94 pct
The issue volume slightly exceeds the 10.96 billion mark volume of expiring six-month Bubills.
The Bundesbank said the weighted average price on the new issue was 98.533. Bids for the paper totalled 21.97 billion marks and the average weighted bid price was 98.515.
